title: fix(about): the update line says Embedded after an OTA on 1.0.0
body:
**Size:** XS
**Affects:** 1.0.0, live on the App Store.

After an over-the-air update, About's update line still reads "Embedded" until a second cold start. `lib/aboutView.ts` reads `isEmbeddedLaunch` once, when `app/about.tsx` first renders, and keeps it.

**Release route:** decided by the owner on 2026-10-14. It is JS-only, so it ships on `release/1.0.0` as an OTA update, and reaches `main` by `git cherry-pick -x`.

### Work

- [ ] Read `Updates.isEmbeddedLaunch` and `Updates.updateId` on each render of About
- [ ] A test in `lib/aboutView.test.ts` for both states

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After an OTA update and one cold start, About names the update
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: An XS JS fix to the shipped 1.0.0, with its route decided, worked from release/1.0.0: in place.
